column1: # Sources for assemble_main_figures.py: one panel per line.
# figure = main-figure number; panel = short name used in the copy's file name,
# starting with its panel letter(s); path = the panel's SVG (PDF and PNG with
# the same stem are copied too), or '-' for a panel made in Illustrator, which
# is listed in the summary but not copied; note = free text (may be empty).
# Relative paths resolve against --base-dir (PROJECT_DIR, the miniprot
# directory); ${POPGEN_DIR} is exported by the wrapper.
# Renumbered 2026-10-26 after Jianbin Wang's review: the Ascaris dN/dS genome
# trace (Fig 3) moved to supplementary fig. S6, so Figs 4-7 became 3-6; the
# gene-set Venn diagram is new as Fig 1D. Lines dated 20261027 are the reruns
# for that review (Venn, codon strip, CBR profile and step); if they ran on
# another day, replace 20261027 with that date in those lines, e.g.
#   sed -i "s/_20261027\//_YYYYMMDD\//" main_figure_sources.tsv
# The five Fig 6 lines name the 2026-10-29 rerun of figure_polymorphism.py
# (panel B as two pairs side by side, after the 2026-10-28 meeting); if it
# ran on another day, replace 20261029 in those lines with that date.
# Re-lettered 2026-11-02 (Figure_1_v8), so the Fig 1 panels are cited in order:
# B gene-set Venn diagram (was D), C dS distributions, D dS tree (was B). The
# panel names below set the copies' file names (Fig1_B_gene_set_venn, ...).
# Point a line at a newer run and rerun the wrapper.
figure
